context_requirements: AGTR1 (AT1 receptor) expression on the cell line
intact angiotensin II signaling or tonic receptor activity
falsifiers: reproducible AGTR1-dependent transcriptional signature at 6 h in any line
dose-dependent changes in AGTR1 target genes after 10 uM ARB treatment
changes in JUN or PPARG target gene sets consistent with ARB activity

evidence.supports: irbesartan altered proliferation and VEGF mRNA in a human endothelial line, but the effect was proliferative rather than a canonical ARB transcriptional program
losartan reduced amiodarone-induced lung fibrosis in rats, indicating ARB activity in vivo but not a direct transcriptional response in the tested cell lines
amiodarone-induced apoptosis in A549 cells was not attributed to angiotensin receptor antagonism, so ARBs are unlikely to produce a strong direct signature in A549
